function: Joint UAV placement and transmit power plus hybrid MRT/ZF beamforming-coefficient design to maximize energy efficiency, learned by a two-stage GNN (p. 1-3).
system: UAV with UPA of 2x3 to 2x7 antennas at 100 m, K = 3-7 single-antenna ground users (MU-MISO), 2.4 GHz; no RIS (p. 2; p. 4).
method: Two-stage GNN (residual graph attention layers, pooling, fully connected layers) trained unsupervised on the energy-efficiency objective with Adam, 120 epochs (p. 3; p. 4).
data_channel: Own model: steering vector with free-space path loss (Eqs. 1-2); users random in 40x40 m; 8,000 training samples per set, 1,000-sample test sets (p. 2; p. 4).
test_conditions: Trained on five (antennas, users) configurations; tested on the same and on unseen antenna counts (2x3, 2x5, 2x7) and user counts (3, 5, 7) (p. 4; p. 5).
baselines: SCA-based algorithm giving the maximum EE per position (Fig. 3); exhaustive search for position; MLP extended from [20] (Table I) (p. 5).
metrics: Energy efficiency [bit/Hz/J] (Tables I-II); inference time; EE surface over positions (Fig. 3) (p. 5).
complexity: Inference time 0.46 ms for GNN versus 0.40 ms for MLP; under 1 ms versus several hours for exhaustive search; no operation or parameter count (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "The channel model follows (2)."; p. 2, Eqs. (1)-(2) define a custom line-of-sight steering-vector channel with free-space loss; no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 5: "scalable to both number of UAV antennas and GUs which are unseen in the training set" (Table I tests other antenna and user counts than in training).
q3_support: p. 5: "where the maximum EE of each position is calculated by an SCA-based algorithm" (Fig. 3, one example) and "a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) is also trained as a baseline", with GNN above MLP in EE in Table I.
q4_support: p. 5: "while it takes less than 1 milliseconds by the proposed model"; Table I lists inference time 0.46 ms (GNN) and 0.40 ms (MLP), a measured runtime.
q5_support: p. 4: "Our implementation is developed using Python 3.10.14 with Pytorch 2.0.0 on a" computer; no link to code or data anywhere, and the data are 8,000 synthetic samples per set from its own simulator.
notes: Area 6 by the order of specificity (aerial link with learned power and beam control, p. 2-3); area 3 would be the alternative by function. UAV placement is above the physical layer, but the model learns it jointly with transmit power and the hybrid MRT/ZF coefficients, so it passes the above_phy check. For q3 the non-learned comparison is one illustrative example (Fig. 3, SCA-based EE surface) plus a runtime remark (p. 5); SCA EE values are not tabulated, so a stricter reading gives q3 = 0.
